hypotheses.H1_wo_free: every H/dx = 16 sweep point meets G1..G4; the band is independent of Wo
hypotheses.H2_layer_resolution: band met iff delta/dx >= 3 (the reading of the existing scope note); FALSIFIED at the stage-1 probe
hypotheses.H3_transient_artefact: off-band points are an unconverged periodic state or a short window, not a spatial limit
hypotheses.H4_noise_floor: off-band error is measurement noise that refining dx cannot remove
hypotheses.H5_two_ceiling: points with steps_per_period >= samples_per_period stay in the band; a sampling-starved point is invalid, not a physics failure, and the same Wo at finer dx recovers
hypotheses.H6_interior_gate_blind_to_wall_layer: G2/G4 (0.15 <= y/H <= 0.85) stay inside 5 % even for delta/dx < 1, while wall-row error grows monotonically with dx/delta
hypotheses.H7_row_mean_floor_share: POST-HOC: the closed-form row-averaging floor accounts for at most half of the wall-row error (so the wall rows are not merely a metric artefact)
hypotheses.H8_wall_error_collapse: POST-HOC: the wall-row error is single-valued in delta/dx -- points with delta/dx within 5 % but different (Wo, H/dx) agree within 2 percentage points

predeclaration.stage1: H1-H4, written before any point of this study ran
predeclaration.stage1_probe_outcome: both passed -> H2 falsified before the sweep; H1 intact
predeclaration.stage2: H5-H6, written after the probe and before the sweep / ladder / sampling points below
predeclaration.stage3_post_hoc: H7-H8, formulated *after* the sweep, when the wall-row errors were seen to saturate near 26-31 % at high Wo.  They are descriptive tests of an explanation, not predeclared predictions, and are labelled as such in the verdict.
predeclaration.note: the H2 prediction text is preserved verbatim in PREDICTIONS so the falsification stays visible

predictions.W0_wo180_r16: pass, and reproduces the committed rung (profile RMS +0.39 %)
predictions.W5_wo800_r16: H6: interior band passes (delta/dx = 1.40); wall rows degrade
predictions.W6_wo1000_r16: H6: interior band passes (delta/dx = 1.13); wall rows degrade further
predictions.W7_wo1250_r16: H6: interior band passes (delta/dx = 0.90); wall rows worst
predictions.W4_wo650_r8: H6: interior band passes at delta/dx = 0.87; wall rows worse than r16
predictions.W4_wo650_r32: H6: interior band passes; wall rows best of the ladder (delta/dx = 3.48)
predictions.W8_wo1600_r16: H5: sampling inadequate (~50 steps per period for 64 samples) -> flagged invalid, verdict not graded
predictions.W8_wo1600_r32: H5: sampling recovered (~101 steps per period) -> interior band passes
predictions.W3_wo500_r24: pass (refinement at fixed Wo cannot change a passing verdict)
predictions.W3_wo500_r16_settle4: pass; same verdict as W3_wo500_r16 (H3 predicts an unchanged verdict means the band is not a transient artefact)

points.prediction: pass (refinement at fixed Wo cannot change a passing verdict)
H6: interior band passes; wall rows best of the ladder (delta/dx = 3.48)

H1_wo_free.note: every admissible H/dx = 16 sweep point is inside G1..G4

H2_layer_resolution.note: the predeclared delta/dx >= 3 rule does not describe the interior gate; it failed at the first probe

H4_noise_floor.note: wall-row error does not fall with refinement -> not a resolution limit

H5_two_ceiling.note: every point with adequate temporal sampling is inside the band; the only out-of-scope point is sampling-starved (steps_per_period < 64) and is recovered by refining dx at the same Wo

H6_interior_gate_blind_to_wall_layer.note: G2/G4 average over 0.15 <= y/H <= 0.85 and therefore cannot see the Stokes layer; the wall rows are the sensitive metric

H7_row_mean_floor_share.note: the row-mean definition explains at most half of the wall-row error; the rest is solver smearing of the sub-dx layer

H8_wall_error_collapse.note: pairs matched in delta/dx but differing in (Wo, H/dx) agree within 2 percentage points: the wall-row error is a function of delta/dx alone
